question: The substances through which objects can be seen but not clearly are called _________ substances.
question_hi: वे पदार्थ जिनके माध्यम से वस्तुओं को देखा जा सकता है लेकिन स्पष्ट रूप से नहीं , उन्हें _________ पदार्थ कहा जाता है।
solution: The substances through which light can pass only partially, allowing objects to be seen but not clearly, are called 'translucent' substances (for example, butter paper or frosted glass). Hence, the correct option is (b).
solution_hi: जिन पदार्थों से होकर प्रकाश आंशिक रूप से गुजर सकता है और जिनके पार वस्तुओं को देखा तो जा सकता है परंतु स्पष्ट रूप से नहीं , उन्हें ' पारभासी ' (translucent) पदार्थ कहते हैं , जैसे कि बटर पेपर या घिसा हुआ काँच। अतः सही विकल्प (b) है।

question: A spoon appearing bent in water is an example of which of the following?
question_hi: पानी में मुड़ा हुआ एक चम्मच निम्नलिखित में से किसका उदाहरण है ?
solution: When a spoon is partially immersed in water, light rays coming from the submerged portion bend as they exit water into the rarer air medium. Due to this refraction, the spoon appears bent at the water-air interface. Hence, the correct option is (b).
solution_hi: जब चम्मच को आंशिक रूप से पानी में डुबाया जाता है , तो पानी के अंदर डूबे हिस्से से आने वाली प्रकाश किरणें हवा के विरल माध्यम में प्रवेश करते समय अपवर्तित (bend) हो जाती हैं। इस अपवर्तन (refraction) के कारण पानी में डूबा चम्मच मुड़ा हुआ दिखाई देता है। अतः सही विकल्प (b) है।

question: What type of image is always formed by a concave lens, regardless of where the object is placed?

options: real, erect, and of same size
options_hi: वास्तविक , सीधा और समान आकार का
solution: A concave lens (diverging lens) always forms a virtual, erect, and diminished image of a real object, regardless of the object's position in front of it. Hence, the correct option is (d).
solution_hi: एक अवतल लेंस ( अपसारी लेंस ) हमेशा किसी वास्तविक वस्तु का केवल आभासी (virtual), सीधा (erect), और वस्तु से छोटा यानी न्यूनीकृत (diminished) प्रतिबिंब ही बनाता है। अतः सही विकल्प (d) है।

question: In the sign convention for lenses, all distances are measured from _________.

question: Stars appear to twinkle more prominently when _________.

solution: When stars are located near the horizon, their light has to travel through a much thicker layer of the Earth's atmosphere to reach our eyes compared to when they are at the zenith (overhead). The increased atmospheric path length enhances refraction fluctuations, making the twinkling effect more prominent. Hence, the correct option is (a).

question: Why do stars twinkle in the night sky?

question: The center of curvature of a concave mirror ______________.

options: is the midpoint of the aperture of the mirror
is the point on the principal axis where the image of an object at infinity is formed
is the geometric center of the spherical surface of which the mirror is a part
is the point where parallel rays of light meet after reflection

मुख्य अक्ष पर वह बिंदु होता है जहाँ किसी वस्तु का अनंत पर प्रतिबिम्ब बनता है

question: From which type of radiation coming from the Sun does the ozone layer protect the Earth's surface?

question: A student projects the image of a tree on a wall using a convex lens. If the size of the image is found to be smaller than the tree, what can be inferred about the position of the tree relative to the lens?

The tree is placed at the focal point of the lens

पेड़ लेंस के फोकस बिंदु पर स्थित है।
solution: For a convex lens, when an object is placed beyond twice the focal length ( ), its image is formed on the other side of the lens, which is real, inverted, and diminished (smaller than the object) and can be projected on a wall (screen). Hence, the correct option is (b).

question: When a person focuses on a nearby object, the ciliary muscles ______________.
question_hi: जब कोई व्यक्ति पास की किसी वस्तु को देखता है , तो सिलिएरी पेशियां ______________ ।
options: contract and make the lens thicker
relax and make the lens thicker
contract and make the lens thinner
relax and make the lens thinner
options_hi: सिकुड़ती हैं और लेंस को मोटा करती हैं
शिथिल होती हैं और लेंस को मोटा करती हैं
सिकुड़ती हैं और लेंस को पतला करती हैं
शिथिल होती हैं और लेंस को पतला करती हैं
solution: When focusing on a nearby object, the ciliary muscles of the eye contract, which relaxes the suspensory ligaments. This causes the crystalline lens to become more rounded and thicker (increased curvature), reducing its focal length so that the nearby object is sharply focused on the retina. Hence, the correct option is (a).

question: The structure of the eye that functions to refract and focus light rays onto the retina is called:

solution: The crystalline lens in the human eye is a transparent biconvex lens that refracts and finely adjusts incoming light rays to focus them precisely onto the retina. Hence, the correct option is (d).
solution_hi: मानव आँख में उपस्थित क्रिस्टलीय लेंस (crystalline lens) एक पारदर्शी द्वि - उत्तल लेंस है , जो आने वाली प्रकाश किरणों को अपवर्तित करके उन्हें रेटिना ( दृष्टिपटल ) पर सटीक रूप से केंद्रित (focus) करने का मुख्य कार्य करता है। अतः सही विकल्प (d) है।

question: How can the problem of near-sightedness (myopia) in the human eye be corrected?

A concave lens of suitable power
A convex lens of suitable power

उपयुक्त क्षमता का एक उत्तल लेंस
solution: Near-sightedness (myopia) is corrected by using spectacles fitted with a 'concave lens' of appropriate focal power, which diverges the incoming light rays to focus them precisely on the retina. Hence, the correct option is (c).
